description: Rotation3: axis-angle, scaled axis, euler angles, product, inverse, vector transform, rotation_between, face_towards, look_at_rh

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: rotation3_from_axis_angle
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_from_scaled_axis
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_scaled_axis
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_angle
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_euler_angles
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_from_euler_angles
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: rotation3_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: rotation3_rotation_between
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_face_towards
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation3_look_at_rh
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
